page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc9i.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 36 Gbps. The lack of integrated GPUs or local NVMe storage represents a clear tradeoff, positioning this instance for workloads that rely entirely on network-attached storage and CPU-bound processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio aligns with compute-intensive profiles, minimizing expenditures on unused memory resources. The high clock speed of 3.4 GHz makes it suitable for workloads such as high-traffic web serving, batch processing, compilation tasks, and compute-heavy application servers that do not require local disk I/O or hardware acceleration.
